source: City of Vancouver Open Data, 'Building Footprints 2009' (building-footprints-2009), the context extent outside the surveyed extent that footprints.json covers, with each footprint's LiDAR height (hgt_agl). Simplified to ~1 m, footprints under 25 m2 dropped. Retrieved 2026-09-30.
encoding: each ring: first vertex absolute, then deltas, in 1e-5 degree steps
